scenario: LLOG.11.9 positive control for LLOG.11.9_after_logical_emit: the same after body emitting a ttl fact compiles. What the clause refuses is the logical lifetime in a self-ending activation, not an emit in a deferred body, and without this pair a refusal of every after-body emit would read the same.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

schema Delayed scope ttl 1_h:
    dummy: Int

rule delayed:
    Trig
->
    after 5_s:
        emit Delayed dummy: 0
